in_marathi.name: Sharvikaasha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Sharvi's Abode
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvikaasha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sharvikaasha is derived from the words Sharvi and Kasha. Sharvi refers to Goddess Sharvi, while Kasha means abode. Thus, Sharvikaasha means the abode or residence of Goddess Sharvi. This name is believed to bring prosperity, wealth, and power.
